title: Real cyber police follow-up on a complaint you filed

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello, this is the cyber crime police station, Hyderabad. You filed a complaint on the 1930 helpline about a UPI fraud.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Yes, I lost twelve thousand rupees.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: We have frozen the beneficiary account. Please come to the station with your bank statement and the complaint number to give a statement.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Remember, the police will never ask you to pay anything or share an OTP on the phone to recover your money.
